SELECT rooms.*,
m.content AS last_message_content, m.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, m.created_at AS last_message_at,
u.name, u.profile_image_url,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.room_id = rooms.room_id AND m3.sender_id != #{login_user_id} AND m3.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count
FROM chat_rooms rooms
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = rooms.project_id
LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id = ( SELECT m2.message_id FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.room_id = rooms.room_id ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )
-- ⭐ 상대방 user join JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN rooms.freelancer_id = #{login_user_id} THEN p.client_id ELSE rooms.freelancer_id END
WHERE rooms.freelancer_id = #{login_user_id} OR p.client_id = #{login_user_id}
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
SELECT cr.room_id, cr.last_message_at, cr.last_message_content, u.name, u.profile_image_url FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cr.freelancer_id WHERE cr.room_id = #{room_id}
